newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Several hurt in Jakarta campaign clash - witnesses.
newsitem.headline: Several hurt in Jakarta campaign clash - witnesses.

text.p: Several people were injured in a clash between supporters of Indonesia's ruling Golkar party and a group of construction workers in Jakarta on Thursday, witnesses said.
The witnesses said Golkar supporters passing a construction site demanded that workers there join them in shouting political slogans.
Stones were thrown after the workers refused, the witnesses said.
They said several people suffered head wounds but the fighting died down before police reached the site.
Sporadic violence has marred the country's campaign for general elections scheduled for May 29.
Golkar was campaigning in Jakarta and on other parts of the main Java island on Thursday under an agreement by the three contesting parties not to campaing in the same area on the same day.
